worldcombat.skill.torment.summary: Torments the target and disrupts repeated attacks. Pokémon cannot use the same move consecutively; ordinary creatures and players must pause between repeated attack methods.
worldcombat.skill.torment.use.0: Break the rhythm of a one-trick foe
worldcombat.skill.torment.use.1: Force the target to switch moves
worldcombat.skill.torment.use.2: Punish an enemy that leans on one combo
worldcombat.skill.torment.description.0: Range %1$s blocks; torment lasts %2$s. Pokémon are blocked from repeating their last move. After an ordinary attack lands, repeats of that melee, arrow or other attack type are blocked for 1.5 seconds; changing methods is allowed.
worldcombat.skill.torment.description.2: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.torment.manner.0: Scorn: longer and farther torment, but slower windup and longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.torment.manner.1: Goad: quicker and cheaper, but a shorter torment and a closer jeer.
worldcombat.skill.torment.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.torment.preference.man: Scorn: longer, farther torment, but windup +2 ticks and cooldown ×1.15; Goad: quicker and cheaper, but a shorter torment and a closer jeer.
Only torment a threat within this distance; smaller only taunts at arm's length, larger chases it down.
By default it jeers only when the foe is about to act, just hit you, or you were just hurt; pick Anytime to jeer whenever a threat shows.
When on, the user may leave its post to jeer; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
